name: Parameters.isAdmissibleComb_vacuumDatum
summary: The named datum is a sum of translates of the vacuum with coefficients the values of Ψ (`isAdmissibleComb_name`), bound into the admissible combination of the single vacuum.

steps.claim: Move the scalar inside the vacuum datum.

The datum is the bind of the named combination (`isAdmissibleComb_name` with g = 0: one coefficient Ψ(x) per matrix x, of modulus ≤ M under every σ by hM, #(matrices) terms) with the single combination of the integral vacuum (`IsAdmissibleComb.single`).
steps.lean:
exact .bind (isAdmissibleComb_name (g := 0) _ _ (by simp) (fun _ _ ⟨p⟩ ↦ by aesop) (fun _ _ ↦ by
    grw [comp_def, hM]) rfl) 1 1 (by simp [IsAdmissibleComb.single, intVacuum])
